question: The magnitude of the steady state plasma concentration that is reached when a monocompartmental drug is administered in continuous perfusion is conditioned by:

options.opa: The time the perfusion is maintained.
options.opb: The relationship between the rate of drug entry into the body (mg / h) and the elimination rate constant.
options.opc: The relationship between the speed of entry to the body (mg / h) and the half-life of elimination of the drug.
options.opd: The relationship between the speed of entry to the body (mg / h) and plasma clearance.
options.ope: The administration of a rapid intravenous shock dose at the start of treatment.
